args: In opensc/src/pkcs15init/pkcs15-myeid.c, inspect myeid_new_file and myeid_create_key. What is the correct project-style way to reject an application DF path that lacks room for a two-byte FID? Identify suitable error code and cleanup/control-flow implications, and note whether the later memcpy in myeid_create_key should also be defensively bounded.

The supplied ASan report says myeid_new_file copies a 16-byte profile application-DF sc_path into file->path and appends two FID bytes without ensuring p->len + 2 <= SC_MAX_PATH_SIZE. This overwrites the adjacent len field. Later myeid_create_key trusts file->path.len in memcpy into sc_pkcs15_prkey_info.path and cleanup dereferences a corrupted aux_data pointer. We need a focused root-cause patch under opensc, preserving normal MyEID key creation and ideally applying defense in depth consistent with local coding conventions.
